name: pdfview
description: Shows PDFs in a webview on every platform StageWebView supports: StageWebView's own, Lime's lime.ui.WebView or OpenFL's StageWebView, with the webview's own viewer on Windows, macOS and iOS and a bundled PDF.js on Linux and Android, where the webview has none.
releasenote: PdfTarget is a structure, anything with load and loadHTML, so lime.ui.WebView works as it stands and showing a PDF no longer compiles StageWebView's own backend into a program that does not use it (on Linux it linked WebKitGTK). PdfTarget.of is gone: pass the webview itself. OpenFL's facade goes through pdfview.openfl.StageWebViewTarget.
